item.title: Ps6 BOM @ 960$ per console
item.description:
The cost of hardware alone for the Ps6 is said to be 960 usd for each console.
This doesn't even include assembly, packaging, shipping, marketing , retailer margin etc.

Will normies pay 1k $ just to be able to play FIFA and Spider man? Seems kinda much for an underpowered PC to me....
